title: Implement MARBLE MultiAgentMaze engine with BFS hints and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task MultiAgentMaze (task_id=17 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-333/solution.py per assets/gc-333/SPEC.md: a grid game engine with role-locked players (pathfinder, blocker, swapper), block pushing and teleport-swapping, a BFS hint system that must treat blocks as obstacles, multi-level progression, and an exact scoring formula with a teamwork bonus. Correctness spans geometry, graph search, and game-state bookkeeping, so stage the work (grid model, movement rules, BFS, scoring/levels), verify each stage against the sealed suite, and track red tests by name between runs. Finish with a green re-verification inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-333/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A staged plan artifact exists before coding covering grid model, movement legality, BFS hints, and scoring/level flow
The sealed suite was executed at each stage with logs retained, showing the red-to-green progression by named test
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including failed runs and dead-end attempts
The sealed suite file is never edited; all recovery happens in workspace/gc-333/solution.py
